services.name: Maui Whale Watching Tour
services.desc: Seasonal humpback whale–watching cruise aboard the No Ka Oi departing from Kihei Boat Ramp. Dec 15th, 2026 - April 1st, 2027

services.name: 3-Hour Turtle Tour with Photos
services.desc: Snorkel Maui’s Turtle Town, explore lava reefs, and search for Hawaiian green sea turtles on a relaxed three-hour adventure from Kihei. Only $99 • 3 Hours • Ages 5+ • Swim w/Turtles

services.name: 2-Hour Molokini Snorkel at Sunrise
services.desc: Snorkel Molokini at sunrise with calmer seas, fewer crowds, vibrant marine life, and unforgettable Haleakalā views—all in two hours. $129 • Ages 5+ • Molokini Guaranteed

services.name: 5-Hour Molokini & Turtle Tour
services.desc: Experience sunrise at Molokini, snorkel two iconic Maui reefs, and enjoy a refreshing shoreside comfort stop on our award-winning five-hour adventure. 5 Hours • Our Award Winning Tour

includes: Gear Included – Just wear a swimsuit and bring a towel – we’ll provide everything else!
